decisions.why: User requested to skip this scoring step

decisions.what: Proxy rotation with 6 working proxies
decisions.why: Amazon blocking - added geographic diversity and rotation

decisions.why: Auto-deploy on push to main, run tests before deployment

decisions.what: Dual-layer keyword enforcement for SEO bullets
decisions.why: AI ignoring validation rules - added stronger prompts + auto-detection fallback

decisions.what: Increased bullet keyword allocation from 12 to 30
decisions.why: AI had too few keywords to work with (2 per bullet → 5 per bullet)

decisions.what: Title duplicate tracking in bullets
decisions.why: Show all keywords including title duplicates with yellow badges

decisions.what: Unique keyword validation for bullets
decisions.why: Enforce minimum 2 unique keywords (not in title) per bullet

decisions.what: Unicode escape sanitization in scoring agent
decisions.why: Fix JSON parse errors from malformed \uXXXX sequences

decisions.what: Keyword reuse between title and bullets
decisions.why: Allow high-volume title keywords in bullets for SEO reinforcement and natural copy

decisions.what: Modified deduplication to preserve title keywords in bullets
decisions.why: Previous logic removed title keywords from bullets, causing 0-keyword issues despite allocation working

decisions.what: Fixed SmartRetryMiddleware text decode error
decisions.why: Amazon returns binary CAPTCHA images - added try-except for response.text access

decisions.what: Replaced Scrapy with Playwright for Amazon scraping
decisions.why: Scrapy easily detected by Amazon - copied working RSS scraper strategy (real browser, stealth mode)

decisions.what: Optimized scraper timeouts for 7-layer fallback strategy
decisions.why: Original 60s per attempt * 7 layers = 420s total, but subprocess timeout was 120s. Reduced to 30s per attempt, increased subprocess to 240s

decisions.what: Fixed data structure mismatch between Playwright and pipeline
decisions.why: Playwright returns flat structure with 'elements', but pipeline expects Scrapy's wrapped 'data' structure. Added normalization in standalone_scraper.py

decisions.what: Fixed missing title and bullets fields for SEO runner
decisions.why: SEO runner expects top-level 'title' field and 'feature-bullets.bullets' key, but Playwright/CloudScraper only returned nested title in elements and used 'text' key. Added title extraction and bullets key to both scrapers, updated wrapper to preserve title field

decisions.what: Integrated SERP API as primary scraping method
decisions.why: SERP API provides 1-2 second response time vs 60+ seconds for Playwright, no blocking/CAPTCHAs, and 100% reliability. Falls back to Playwright then Scrapy if SERP API fails

decisions.what: Fixed malformed relevancy_score JSON validation error
decisions.why: AI occasionally generates 'relevancy_score': ': 10' instead of 'relevancy_score': 10, causing Pydantic validation errors. Added field_validator to sanitize malformed scores

decisions.what: Added keywords_duplicated_from_title field to OptimizedContent schema
decisions.why: Frontend needs to display keywords that are duplicated from title (for SEO reinforcement) separately from unique keywords. Field was being set but Pydantic was stripping it

decisions.what: Fixed frontend to display both title and bullet duplicates with yellow badges
decisions.why: Frontend was only checking keywords_duplicated_from_other_bullets, missing title duplicates. Now checks both and shows appropriate tooltips ('Also in title' vs 'Already in another bullet')

decisions.what: Fixed image structure in all scrapers to match frontend expectations
decisions.why: Frontend expects images.all_images nested structure but scrapers returned flat array. Updated SERP API, Playwright, and CloudScraper to return {all_images, main_image, image_count}

decisions.what: Added wake-up health check for Render cold start
decisions.why: Render puts backend to sleep after inactivity. First request times out while waking up. Added wakeUpBackend() method that sends 2-3 health checks before main API call to ensure backend is ready

decisions.what: Fixed keyword detection to check ALL keywords in content (Task 2)
decisions.why: Previously only checked keywords AI claimed it used, missing many keywords actually present in text. Now checks ALL Relevant + Design-Specific + Branded keywords against title/bullet content for accurate detection and volume calculation

decisions.what: Updated bullet point rule to allow strategic keyword repetition (Task 4)
decisions.why: Changed from 'NO TITLE REDUNDANCY' to 'STRATEGIC KEYWORD REINFORCEMENT'. AI now repeats top 2-3 high-volume title keywords in bullets for Amazon SEO ranking boost, while still adding 2-3 unique keywords per bullet. This enables yellow badge functionality and follows Amazon SEO best practices

decisions.what: Fixed total search volume calculation to include branded keywords
decisions.why: Volume map in seo_keyword_filter.py only included Relevant + Design-Specific keywords, missing branded keywords (e.g., 'beauty blender' 71K volume). This caused optimized content to show lower volume than original. Added branded_keywords to volume map extraction

decisions.what: Added explicit volume-based keyword ordering instruction for bullets
decisions.why: AI was randomly selecting keywords from bullet_keywords list instead of using highest-volume keywords first. Added explicit instruction to use keywords sequentially (Bullet 1: keywords #1-3, Bullet 2: #4-6, etc.) since they're pre-sorted by volume. This ensures optimized content has maximum search volume

decisions.what: Fixed bullet keyword allocation to provide 8 keywords per bullet (48 total for 6 bullets)
decisions.why: Previous allocation only fetched 20 keywords for bullets, but after filtering title keywords only ~8 remained. Increased to fetch 68 keywords (48 target + 20 buffer) so each bullet gets 8 keywords to naturally integrate 4-6 per bullet. This ensures high total search volume

decisions.what: Filter title keywords from bullet_keywords before passing to AI
decisions.why: With allow_reuse=True, bullet_keywords included all title keywords at the top (sorted by volume). AI would use sequential ordering but get title keywords first. Now filters out title keywords after allocation so bullet_keywords contains ONLY new keywords sorted by volume

decisions.what: Updated AI prompt to prioritize NEW keywords over title repetition
decisions.why: STRATEGIC KEYWORD REINFORCEMENT rule was too strong, causing AI to only repeat title keywords and ignore new keywords. Changed to 'NEW KEYWORDS MANDATORY' with strict sequential allocation (Bullet 1: #0-3, Bullet 2: #4-7, etc.) and minimum 4 NEW keywords per bullet. Title keywords now optional for natural flow

decisions.what: Fixed frontend bullet volume calculation to use backend's pre-calculated values
decisions.why: Frontend was manually filtering title keywords and recalculating volumes, which was redundant and error-prone. Backend already calculates total_search_volume correctly per bullet. Changed to simply sum bullet.total_search_volume values. This fixes the 'optimized volume < original volume' display issue

redis_job_storage.notes: Persistent job storage with file-based fallback

anti_blocking.notes: User-Agent rotation, proxy rotation, smart retry, delay randomization (Scrapy fallback only)

playwright_scraper.notes: Triple-layer scraping: 3 Playwright configs + Scrapy + 3 CloudScraper configs. Random delays, content validation, advanced headers - fully matches RSS scraper approach

proxy_rotation.notes: 6 working proxies (DE, BR, IT, RU, IN, SG), random rotation strategy

ci_cd_pipeline.notes: Auto-deploy on push to main after tests pass

seo_bullet_keyword_enforcement.notes: 30 keywords per 6 bullets, keyword reuse between title/bullets for SEO reinforcement, title duplicate tracking with yellow badges, unique keyword validation, auto-detection fallback

scoring_unicode_sanitization.notes: Fixes invalid \uXXXX escape sequences from AI output before JSON parsing

debt: Free proxies unreliable - consider paid proxy service for production
Scraper needs correct product URL - ensure ASIN matches CSV keywords (makeup sponge vs strawberries)
Playwright needs browser installation after pip install (playwright install chromium)
7-layer scraping takes ~120-180s total - consider reducing layers or parallelizing for faster results

env.SERPAPI_API_KEY: SERP API key for fast Amazon scraping (optional, enables 1-2s scraping vs 60+s)
env.PLAYWRIGHT_HEADLESS: Headless mode: true/false/new (default: new for best stealth)
